answer: Sheets are tried at the yard arm before they are sold, and the sewer watches the trial herself, hand on the rope. Cord wool sail sewer rope bond covers the watching: a bond wool sail sewers lodge after sewing loft trials. The falcon is the first trial watched, the quartz the last before the sheet is paid for, and the basalt is the paying, the coins counted on the bench. A forger would watch 61 false trials and count 61 false coins.
